known.via: English Wikipedia "Falerno del Massico" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A red wine DOC in Caserta province, in Campania, from five communes including Carinola and Sessa Aurunca. It was classified in 1989 and comes from the area of ancient Rome's falernian wine.
